# alberyt.xyz

> Albert Gabor builds AI automation and software for businesses that run on paperwork and manual processes: document pipelines, workflow automation and self-hosted systems, on infrastructure the client controls. Based in Timișoara, Romania; works in Romanian and English.

The site describes what he does, his work, what he is building now, and how to book a 20-minute call. It is self-hosted on his own servers and available in English and Romanian.

## What he does
- Documents into data: pipelines that turn PDFs, scans and emails into checked, structured data, so people review only the exceptions. Starts with one document type, into one system.
- Workflows that run themselves: recurring requests, approvals and reports automated, with every run logged and a person in the loop where a decision matters. Starts with one recurring process.
- Private AI on the client's own servers: AI search and assistants over internal files, on the client's servers or with EU-based providers. Starts with one knowledge base or one internal tool.
- Any engagement can start with a fixed-scope, two-week pilot on one process.
- How he works: data stays on the client's servers or in the EU; every automated step is logged; the scope is agreed before work starts. He has run his own systems the same way since January 2024: about 130 containers, backed up weekly.

## Work
- [EHDS-Service](https://github.com/Albert-4096/EHDS-Service): turns Romanian hospital discharge PDFs into valid HL7 FHIR R4 bundles through a nine-stage pipeline (Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript). Built at HackTM 2026, his first hackathon, where Albert led the build with his team and it won the Product Innovation track (€2,000 team prize, sponsored by Aumovio). Demo with a synthetic patient: https://ehds.alberyt.xyz
- K-Project (own project, private, 2026): ingests, transcribes, embeds and searches thousands of documents and recordings, and AI assistants can query it directly. Runs on his own archive of 5,500+ items.

## Lab
- Guest check-in desk for TEDxAristide Demetriade (September 2026).
- [Cryptography Atlas](https://crypto.alberyt.xyz): a visual guide to a few cryptographic algorithms, their uses and quirks.
- [LCG Visualizer](https://lcg.alberyt.xyz): a linear congruential generator's output as a grayscale image, checked against the Hull–Dobell theorem.
- [mail-platform](https://github.com/Albert-4096/mail-platform): webmail for his own domains on top of Resend, with required TOTP.
- [Auth System](https://github.com/Albert-4096/auth-system): a small dockerized authentication backend (Argon2, JWT, PostgreSQL).
- Open-source fixes merged upstream: [NandhaKishorM/laya#264](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/264) and [Freika/dawarich#3595](https://github.com/Freika/dawarich/pull/3595).
- [Nonlinear Thinking](https://nonlinear-thinking.alberyt.xyz) and [Opere BAC](https://github.com/Albert-4096/opere-bac-website), a study site for the Romanian Baccalaureate literature exam.

## About
- First-year BSc in Artificial Intelligence at West University of Timișoara (UVT). Got into AI through neuroscience, then machine learning, security and running his own servers.
- Developer at Aviseco and project manager at TEDx.
- Artificial Intelligence Olympiad, national stage (2025, 2026). Cybersecurity Olympiad, national stage (2025). Both are national-stage qualifications, not prizes.
- Cambridge C1 Advanced (2025).
